corrections.detail: Initial command used nonexistent CIS.Core.slnx and exited MSB1009 without compiling. Retained build-initial.log; selected the actual CisLib.slnx under the pinned language directory. Corrected build passed with zero warnings/errors.

Initial guard classified the runtime type-name fallback as unrestricted reflection: Type.Name is declared on MemberInfo. Preserved the failing native log/TRX, explicitly allowed only the MemberInfo get_Name identity accessor, and retained negative controls for GetProperties/serialization/Data/Source/HelpLink/ToString.

Default Python cp1252 reading rewrote several existing UTF-8 symbols in four documentation files. Review caught it before commit. Stopped the confirmed owned replay (exit -1 during preparation), retained interruption log/record, restored the original characters and recaptured explicit UTF-8 inputs. Shipping C# and native test inputs were unchanged.
